description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSkill class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable. It is part of the OrangeHRM system and handles filtering employee skills within the reporting module by adding query conditions and normalizing skill data for reports.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Class for filtering employee skill data in reports, supports query modifications and data normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and value.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the query.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Transforms the skill ID into a structured array with id and label for report output.
